passages.title: Meeting Time
passages.text:
[Man]: Hi Sarah, are we still meeting at quarter past five?
[Woman]: Well, my class doesn't finish until five o'clock, and it takes me half an hour to get to the café. Can we make it quarter to six instead?
[Man]: That's a bit late because the film starts at six. Let's say half past five.
[Woman]: Okay, see you then.

passages.title: Buying a Bag
passages.text:
[Woman]: Look at my new bag! I wanted a small round one, but when I got to the shop, I saw this square leather one and fell in love with it.
[Man]: It's nice. I thought you were looking for one with long straps to wear over your shoulder?
[Woman]: I was, but this one has short handles and it's actually much easier to carry.

passages.title: Lunch Plans
passages.text:
[Man]: Shall we go to that new Italian restaurant by the river for lunch?
[Woman]: I'd love to, but it's always so busy. Why don't we just get some sandwiches and sit in the park? It's really sunny today.
[Man]: Actually, I heard there's a lovely café inside the museum that has outdoor seating. It's quiet too.
[Woman]: Oh, that sounds perfect. Let's go there.

passages.title: Birthday Present
passages.text:
[Man]: I need to get a birthday present for my sister. I was thinking of a silver necklace.
[Woman]: She doesn't really wear jewelry, does she? What about that book she wanted?
[Man]: Our parents already bought her that. I think I'll get her a nice wool scarf instead. It's getting cold now.
[Woman]: That's a lovely idea.

passages.title: Lost Keys
passages.text:
[Man]: I can't find my keys anywhere! I thought I left them on the kitchen table next to my wallet.
[Woman]: Did you check your coat pocket? You had them when we came inside.
[Man]: Yes, I checked. Oh, wait, I remember now. I put them down on the shelf by the front door when I was taking off my shoes.
[Woman]: Ah, yes, there they are!

passages.title: Weather Forecast
passages.text: [Presenter]: Here is the weather forecast for tomorrow. It will be a very wet start to the day, with heavy rain during the morning. However, by lunchtime, the rain will clear up, leaving us with cloudy but dry skies for the rest of the afternoon. We might even see some sunshine by the evening.

passages.title: Jack's Sport
passages.text:
[Woman]: Did you go to the indoor climbing wall yesterday, Jack?
[Man]: I wanted to, but it was fully booked. My brother suggested going for a bike ride instead, but then his bicycle had a flat tire. So we ended up playing tennis at the local club.
[Woman]: At least you did some exercise!

questions.question: What time will they meet?
questions.explanation: The woman suggests 5:45 (quarter to six) because her class ends at 5:00 and it takes 30 minutes to travel. However, the man suggests 5:30 (half past five) because the film starts at 6:00, and she agrees.

questions.question: Which bag did the woman buy?
questions.explanation: She wanted a small round one but bought a square leather one instead. Although she originally looked for long shoulder straps, she bought one with short handles because it is easier to carry.
options: a) A square bag with long shoulder straps
b) A square bag with short handles

questions.question: Where are they going to have lunch?
questions.explanation: They reject the Italian restaurant because it's busy. The woman suggests the park, but they agree on the museum café because it has outdoor seating and is quiet.

questions.question: What is the man going to buy his sister?
questions.explanation: He decides against the necklace because she doesn't wear jewelry, and her parents already bought the book. He chooses the wool scarf.

questions.question: Where did the man leave his keys?
questions.explanation: He thought they were on the kitchen table and checked his coat pocket, but finally remembered and found them on the shelf by the front door.
options: a) On the shelf by the front door

questions.question: What will the weather be like tomorrow afternoon?
questions.explanation: The morning will be rainy, the afternoon will be cloudy but dry, and the evening might bring some sunshine.

questions.question: Which sport did the boy do yesterday?
questions.explanation: Climbing was fully booked and the bike ride was cancelled due to a flat tire, so they ended up playing tennis.
